name: Aider
setupCommands: echo '#!/bin/bash' > $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo 'args=("$@")' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo 'for i in "${!args[@]}"; do' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo '  if [[ "${args[$i]}" == "--model" ]]; then' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo '    args[$((i+1))]="__MODEL__"' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo '  fi' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo 'done' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider && echo 'exec "__AIDER__" --yes "${args[@]}"' >> $HOME/aider-wrapper/aider
